note: Evals are read-only — they check output style, not side effects. Safe to run anywhere.

evals.prompt: terse mode. how many test files in this repo?
evals.expected_output: A bare count, no preamble, no restatement of the question, no trailing offer to help. Something like `14` or `14 — all under tests/`. Not "I found 14 test files in the repo. Let me know if...".

evals.prompt: be extremely concise from now on. run the test suite and tell me how it went.
evals.expected_output: Tests actually run. Report is fragments, one line per fact, e.g. `3 failing — parser suite. auth.test.ts:88`. Failures are stated explicitly and not softened or omitted; a negation is never dropped.

evals.prompt: caveman mode. now write the PR body for this branch.
evals.expected_output: Chat reporting is terse, but the PR body itself is written in full, normal prose — terse applies to reporting to the user, not to artifacts written for other people.

evals.prompt: short answers only. explain why this code deadlocks.
evals.expected_output: Padding removed but the explanation is complete — the causal chain is all there. The skill does not truncate an explanation-shaped deliverable into fragments that omit the reasoning.
